cards.public_summary: Dallas Goedert took a rep at H-back in an offset-I look, as the team has not clarified whether it will carry a fullback.
cards.evidence:
Dallas Goedert just got a look as the H-back in the off-set I.

Sean Mannion has played it close to the vest about whether they’ll have a fullback
cards.commentary: This suggests Goedert could be part of heavy personnel packages, but one H-back look does not establish a larger receiving role or projected workload.
cards.author: BKubena
